SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
（印：SUPP... ...INE / No. 9128 / ... 30 ...）

S.I., Special Branch, Station File No.................... Date January 28, 1942.

SUBJECT: P.W.D. - discharge of 58 truck chauffeurs -
demand for issue of wages and superannuation
funds due to them

At 11 a.m., January 26, 58 truck drivers hitherto
employed by the S.M.C. Public Works Department, who
were discharged on December 31, 1941, owing to the
laying up of a number of vehicles as a result of the
fuel shortage, assembled in the P.W.D. offices and
demanded the immediate issue of the two months' wages
and provident fund which has been promised them. No
demand was made for an increase in the amount due, but
only for the expedition of payment which they would
have been made in the early part of January, 1942.
They stated that they were anxious to return to their
native places, where the cost of living is lower than
in Shanghai, and refused to leave the offices until
they had been paid.

The assistance of the Uniform Branch of Central
Station and Special Branch was requested. D.I. Kao
Yen-ken attended. The gathering was advised to
disperse and three delegates were left to continue
negotiations with the P.W.D. authorities.

The three delegates were later received by Mr.
Harbottle, who stated that the matter was in the hands
of the Secretariat and he was waiting for a reply as
to when the money could be issued.

The delegates then decided to request D.I. Kao
to accompany them to interview the Chinese Deputy
Secretary Mr. T.K. Ho. D.I. Kao communicated with
Mr. T.K. Ho, who stated that the issue of the money
due to the drivers had been approved by the Secretary-

特务科情报员，分站档案号.................... 日期 1942年1月28日。

主题：工务局 - 解雇58名卡车司机 -
要求发放欠付的工资及养老金

1月26日上午11时，此前受雇于工部局工务局的58名卡车司机聚集在工务局办公室。这些司机因燃料短缺导致部分车辆停驶，已于1941年12月31日被解雇。他们要求立即发放曾承诺给他们的两个月工资和公积金。他们并未要求增加应付金额，仅要求加快支付速度，这笔款项本应在1942年1月上旬支付。他们表示急于返回生活成本低于上海的家乡，并在收到付款前拒绝离开办公室。

请求中央车站制服警员分支及特务科协助。督察高延根（Kao Yen-ken）到场。集会人群被劝散，留下三名代表继续与工务局当局谈判。

随后，哈博特尔先生（Mr. Harbottle）接见了这三名代表，他表示此事正由秘书处处理，他正在等待关于何时可以发放款项的回复。

代表们随后决定请求高督察陪同他们会见华籍副秘书何铁庚先生（Mr. T.K. Ho）。高督察与何铁庚先生取得联系，何先生表示，向司机发放欠款事宜已获秘书

It will be noted that these workers have already

Shanghai any longer with their families while remaining
without work.

at 225 Wuting Road.
3. Sung Chi-hang (沈其杭), Driver No. 75, residing
at 303 West Sz Wen Li, Tatung Road.
In connection with this case, D.S. Yamamoto on
January 27, communicated with Mr. Hayashi and was
informed that he would refer the matter to the Japanese
High Command and that most probably the workers would
be paid on January 28 or 29.
The workers' delegates were accordingly informed
on January 27.

S...1. Special Branch...........File No.................... Date November 5, 1941,

SUBJECT: Public Works Department Shunten Road
Depot - unrest among drivers.

unrest exists among the 87 drivers in the
employ of the Shunteh Road Depot of the Public Works
Department as a result of dismissal of the following
four of their colleagues :

(1) Tseu Ding Mee (周定義), driver No. 4
(2) Li Hsueh Sze (李學書), driver No. 54
(3) Fan Ah Foh (潘阿福), driver No. 7C
(4) Tsang Yung Sung (張榮生), driver No. 7

They were discharged on October 2, 1941 for
misappropriation of gasoline. However, the chauffeurs
denied the accusation and explained that the excessive
consumption of gasoline was chiefly due to the speed
and service in which a vehicle is engaged.

In this connection it is ascertained that
since January 1941, the Public Works Department
authorities have carried out a series of tests on all
their vehicles in the presence of the respective drivers,
as a result of which it was proved that the average
consumption of gasoline for each vehicle is approximately
11½ miles per gallon, with an excess allowance of
10% for wastage.

Drivers who maintain a good average mileage
are granted a special bonus up to $100.00 per month.

The drivers allege that Inspector RAJENOFF
has adopted oppressive measures by having the chauffeurs
dismissed under false pretext. According to the
chauffeurs, representations have been made to the Public
Works Department Authorities for the reinstatement of

报告

特务科第1站...........档案号.................... 日期 1941年11月5日，

主题：工务局顺泰路车厂 - 司机中的不安情绪。

工务局顺泰路车厂雇用的87名司机中存在着不安情绪，原因是他们的以下四位同事被解雇：

(1) 周定义（Tseu Ding Mee），4号司机
(2) 李学书（Li Hsueh Sze），54号司机
(3) 潘阿福（Fan Ah Foh），7C号司机
(4) 张荣生（Tsang Yung Sung），7号司机

他们于1941年10月2日因侵吞汽油而被解雇。然而，司机们否认了这一指控，并解释说汽油消耗过量主要是由于车辆行驶的速度和服务性质所致。

就此而言，经查实，自1941年1月以来，工务局当局在各相关司机在场的情况下，对其所有车辆进行了一系列测试，结果证明每辆车的平均汽油消耗量约为每加仑行驶11½英里，并允许有10%的损耗余量。

保持良好平均里程数的司机可获得每月高达100.00元的特别奖金。

司机们指控拉杰诺夫督察（Inspector RAJENOFF）采取压迫性措施，以虚假借口解雇司机。据司机称，已向工务局当局提出申诉，要求复职

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

S. 1., Special Branch Station File No. Date November 8, 1941.

SUBJECT: Public Works Department Shunteh Road
Depot - Unrest among drivers.

During the afternoon of November 6, 1941,
the three dismissed drivers - TSEU DING NEE (周定義),
LI HSUEH SUE (李學書) and PAN AN FOH (潘阿福) -
appeared at the Shunteh Road Depot with a view to
securing reinstatement, but without any result. On
the morning of November 7, they called at Special
Branch and appealed for assistance in obtaining
re-employment or a gratuity. The request was
conveyed to Mr. HARBOTTLE of the P.W.D., who stated
that their reinstatement or the issue of a gratuity
could not possibly be considered. The dismissed
drivers were informed of this decision and were
warned against creating any trouble among their
former colleagues.

（批：Copy to Mr. Harbottle, P.W.D. 8.11.41 B.L. Sent J. Boyd）

When questioned in the Detective Office the accused
stated that he, together with two others named Wong
Gee Chong (王其昌) and Wong Dau Ziang (王道祥), had
organized a P.W.D. workmen's union (not recognized).

accused and his accomplices are trying to expand

intimidation in the hope of forcing them to do so.

At 10 a.m. 22-2-41, Chief Inspector Holt
of the P.W.D. Highways Department brought to this
station P.W.D. coolies Nos. 266 and 270 (for names
see overleaf), who reported that, at about 4.30 p.m.
20-2-41, outside Shunteh Road Depot, two dismissed
P.W.D. coolies (for descriptions see overleaf) had
approached them after they had drawn their wages
and stating that they had established a new P.W.D.
Union, demanded that both coolies pay them $1.00 for
"Union fees".

Both coolies refused to pay over any money,
whereupon the two dismissed coolies intimidated them
by use of threats and by assaulting coolie No. 266.

The undersigned and C.D.S. 71 questioned
the two complainants and further ascertained that a
number of other P.W.D. coolies had also been intimi-
dated by the two loafers who usually visited Shunteh
Road Depot when the coolies were drawing their wages.
No information could be obtained that the two cul-
prits were actually attempting to start a union.
They apparently only mentioned Union fees as a pre-
tense to extort money.

Enquiries at the scene of the offence failed
to locate any persons who knew the addresses of the
two wanted men although they are known to a number
of P.W.D. coolies.

C.D.S. 71 will co-operate with the two
complainants in an effort to locate the two wanted
men and effect their arrest.

Mr. Holt has agreed to detain them if he
sees them loitering in the vicinity of Shunteh

1941年2月22日上午10点，公共工程部（P.W.D.）道路处首席督察霍尔特（Holt）将公共工程部（P.W.D.）苦力第266号和270号（姓名见背面）带到本警局，他们报告称，1941年2月20日下午4:30左右，在顺泰路堆栈外，两名被解雇的公共工程部（P.W.D.）苦力（描述见背面）在他们领取工资后接近他们，声称已成立一个新的公共工程部（P.W.D.）工会，要求两名苦力各支付1.00美元作为“工会费”。

两名苦力拒绝支付任何款项，随后这两名被解雇的苦力通过威胁和殴打第266号苦力对他们进行恐吓。

签署人与刑事侦缉处第71号警探对两名报案人进行了讯问，并进一步查明，还有其他一些公共工程部（P.W.D.）苦力也受到这两名懒汉的恐吓，他们通常在苦力领薪时出现在顺泰路堆栈。未能获得任何信息表明这两名罪犯确实试图成立工会。他们显然只是以工会费为借口进行勒索。

在犯罪现场进行的查询未能找到任何知道这两名通缉犯住址的人，尽管许多公共工程部（P.W.D.）苦力认识他们。

刑事侦缉处第71号警探将与两名报案人合作，努力寻找这两名通缉犯并将其逮捕。

pages.en:
Copyfor Special Branch

"B"
Sinza
Misc. 434/41.
Sept. 4,
41.
1.

Trouble at Shunteh Road P. .D. Depot.

At 10 a.m. 4-9-41, a telephone message was
received by the Officer i/c. Sinzu from Gordon Road
Station, to the effect that there was a trouble at the
Shunteh Road P. .D. Depot in respect of drivers.
C.D.C. 135 and the undersigned proceeded to the
above Depot for enquiries. In an interview, Mr.
Weinbenger of the Transport office, P. .D., states
that instructions had been received from the Head
Office that 4 drivers were to be dismissed for being
negligent in driving vehicles, which resulted in the
excessive use of gasoline.
At 6 a.m. even date, when it was announced at the
P. .D. Depot that the services of these 4 drivers were
dispensed with, some 90 other drivers in same employ,
who were in favour of the dismissed drivers, refused
to work.
Head Office of the P. .D. was informed of the
action taken by the other drivers, and a further order
was issued allowing the 4 drivers concerned to remain
until a test in connection with their skill is held
and the question regarding their dismissal is now
pending.
pages.zh:
特科副本

“B”
静安寺
杂项 434/41。
1941年9月4日。
1.

顺德路公共事业部车场发生纠纷。

1941年9月4日上午10时，静安寺巡捕房负责人接到戈登路巡捕房的电话通知，称顺德路公共事业部（P. .D.）车场在司机方面发生纠纷。中央侦探队第135号警探及本人前往上述车场进行调查。在面谈中，公共事业部运输处的温伯格（Weinbenger，音译）先生表示，总部已下达指令，因4名司机驾驶车辆疏忽，导致汽油过度消耗，故予以解雇。
同日早上6时，当在公共事业部车场宣布解雇这4名司机时，同一雇主旗下的约90名其他司机因支持被解雇的司机，拒绝工作。
公共事业部总部获悉其他司机采取的行动后，又发布了一项命令，允许涉及的4名司机留职，直至举行有关其技能的测试为止，目前关于解雇他们的问题尚待解决。
